paragraphs: Met Éireann has warned about bad weather today. There are Status Yellow warnings for wind and rain in six counties.
The warning for Cork, Waterford and Kerry starts at 1pm today. It ends at midnight. The warning for Galway, Mayo and Sligo starts at 3pm. It ends at 4am on Tuesday.
There will be heavy rain and strong winds. Some roads may flood. It will be hard to drive or cycle. The wind can blow things around.
Drive slowly and be careful. Do not drive through flood water. Tie down things in your garden. Stay away from the sea.
On Tuesday, the weather will be better, with sunny spells and some showers.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局今天發出惡劣天氣警告。
六個郡有黃色風雨警報。
科克、沃特福德和凱瑞的警報從今天下午 1 點開始。
警報在午夜結束。
高威、梅奧和斯萊戈的警報從下午 3 點開始。
警報在週二凌晨 4 點結束。
將會有大雨和強風。
有些道路可能淹水。
開車或騎腳踏車會很困難。
風可能把東西吹得到處都是。
請慢慢開車並小心。
不要開車穿越積水。
把花園裡的東西綁好。
遠離海邊。
週二天氣會好轉，有晴朗時段和一些陣雨。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued Status Yellow wind and rain warnings for six counties in the south and west of Ireland today, Monday.
The warnings for Cork, Waterford and Kerry are in place from 1pm until midnight. A separate warning for Galway, Mayo and Sligo begins at 3pm and lasts until 4am on Tuesday.

Spells of heavy rain will come with strong and gusty winds from the south-east. Met Éireann says there may be some flooding in places, difficult conditions for driving and cycling, and poor visibility. Loose objects and branches could be blown onto roads.
Rain will reach Ulster in the evening, with some snow or sleet on high ground. There is also a gale warning at sea along the south and east coasts.

People should slow down, leave extra space between vehicles and never drive through flood water. They should tie down garden furniture and keep away from the coast. Tuesday will be brighter, with sunny spells and showers.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭氣象局今天（週一）對愛爾蘭南部和西部六個郡發布黃色風雨警報。
科克、沃特福德和凱瑞的警報從下午 1 點生效至午夜。
另一個針對高威、梅奧和斯萊戈的警報從下午 3 點開始，持續到週二凌晨 4 點。
陣陣大雨將伴隨來自東南方的強陣風。
氣象局說，部分地區可能淹水，開車和騎車的路況困難，能見度也不佳。
鬆動的物品和樹枝可能被吹到路上。
雨勢將在傍晚抵達阿爾斯特，高地會有一些雪或雨夾雪。
南部和東部海岸的海面上也有大風警報。
民眾應減速、與其他車輛保持更多距離，絕對不要開車穿越積水。
應把花園家具綁好並遠離海岸。
週二天氣會較晴朗，有晴朗時段和陣雨。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued Status Yellow wind and rain warnings for six counties across Munster and Connacht as an unsettled weather system sweeps across the country today.
The warnings for Cork, Waterford and Kerry are valid from 1pm until 11.59pm on Monday. A separate alert for Galway, Mayo and Sligo runs from 3pm on Monday until 4am on Tuesday.

Forecasters expect spells of heavy rain combined with strong, gusty south-easterly winds. Possible impacts include localised flooding, hazardous travelling conditions, reduced visibility and debris being blown onto roads.
The rain will spread to Ulster during the evening, with some wintry falls on hills, before easing overnight. A gale warning is also in force for the south and east coasts.

Motorists are advised to reduce speed, allow extra braking distance and avoid driving through floodwater. Householders should secure loose garden items, and the public should stay away from exposed coastal areas. Conditions are expected to improve on Tuesday, with sunny spells and scattered showers.
sentZh: 隨著不穩定的天氣系統今天橫掃全國，愛爾蘭氣象局對芒斯特省和康諾特省六個郡發布黃色風雨警報。
科克、沃特福德和凱瑞的警報從週一下午 1 點生效至晚上 11 點 59 分。
另一個針對高威、梅奧和斯萊戈的警報從週一下午 3 點持續到週二凌晨 4 點。
預報員預期將有陣陣大雨，伴隨強勁的東南陣風。
可能的影響包括局部淹水、危險的行車狀況、能見度降低，以及雜物被吹上道路。
雨勢將於傍晚擴及阿爾斯特，丘陵地會有一些雨雪，之後在夜間減弱。
南部和東部海岸也有大風警報生效。
建議駕駛人減速、預留更長的煞車距離，並避免開車穿越積水。
住戶應固定花園中鬆動的物品，民眾也應遠離空曠暴露的沿海地區。
預計週二天氣將好轉，有晴朗時段和零星陣雨。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued Status Yellow wind and rain warnings for six counties in Munster and Connacht as a turbulent weather system barrels across the country today.
The alerts for Cork, Waterford and Kerry are in effect from 1pm until 11.59pm on Monday, while a separate warning for Galway, Mayo and Sligo runs from 3pm until 4am on Tuesday.

Bouts of torrential rain, accompanied by blustery south-easterly winds, are forecast. The national forecaster has flagged the risk of localised flooding, treacherous travelling conditions, impaired visibility and debris strewn across roads.
The rain is set to encroach on Ulster in the evening, with wintry falls on high ground, before abating overnight. A gale warning is also in force along the southern and eastern coasts.

Motorists are urged to curb their speed, leave ample braking distance and steer clear of floodwater. Householders should secure garden furniture, and the public should shun exposed coastal spots. A respite is anticipated on Tuesday, with sunny intervals and scattered showers.
sentZh: 隨著一個狂暴的天氣系統今天猛烈橫越全國，愛爾蘭氣象局對芒斯特省和康諾特省六個郡發布黃色風雨警報。
科克、沃特福德和凱瑞的警報從週一下午 1 點生效至晚上 11 點 59 分，另一個針對高威、梅奧和斯萊戈的警報則從下午 3 點持續到週二凌晨 4 點。
預報將有陣陣傾盆大雨，伴隨狂暴的東南風。
國家氣象單位已點出局部淹水、險惡的行車狀況、能見度受損以及道路上散落雜物的風險。
雨勢預計傍晚逐步擴及阿爾斯特，高地會有雨雪，之後在夜間減弱。
南部和東部沿海也有大風警報生效。
呼籲駕駛人控制車速、預留充足的煞車距離，並避開積水。
住戶應固定花園家具，民眾也應避開空曠暴露的沿海地點。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued Status Yellow wind and rain warnings for six counties in Munster and Connacht, as a substantial weather system moves across the country today.
The warnings for Cork, Waterford and Kerry are valid from 1pm until 11.59pm on Monday, whereas a separate warning for Galway, Mayo and Sligo will remain in force from 3pm until 4am on Tuesday.

Periods of heavy rainfall, accompanied by strong and gusty south-easterly winds, are anticipated. Consequently, the forecaster has highlighted the potential for localised flooding, hazardous travelling conditions, diminished visibility and the displacement of loose debris.

The rain is expected to extend into Ulster during the evening, with wintry precipitation on elevated ground, before gradually subsiding overnight. In addition, a gale warning is in operation along the southern and eastern coasts.

Motorists are advised to reduce their speed, maintain additional braking distance and avoid floodwater. Residents should secure outdoor objects and refrain from visiting exposed coastal areas. Conditions are expected to improve on Tuesday, with sunny spells and scattered showers.

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued Status Yellow wind and rain warnings for six counties across Munster and Connacht as an unsettled weather system sweeps across the country today.
The warnings for Cork, Waterford and Kerry are valid from 1pm until 11.59pm on Monday. A separate alert for Galway, Mayo and Sligo runs from 3pm on Monday until 4am on Tuesday.

Forecasters expect spells of heavy rain combined with strong, gusty south-easterly winds. Possible impacts include localised flooding, hazardous travelling conditions, reduced visibility and debris being blown onto roads.
The rain will spread to Ulster during the evening, with some wintry falls on hills, before easing overnight. A gale warning is also in force for the south and east coasts.

Motorists are advised to reduce speed, allow extra braking distance and avoid driving through floodwater. Householders should secure loose garden items, and the public should stay away from exposed coastal areas. Conditions are expected to improve on Tuesday, with sunny spells and scattered showers.
